entities.summary: Dursunbey, formerly Balat, is a municipality and district of Balıkesir Province, Turkey. Its area is 1,719 km2, and its population is 33,333 (2022). The mayor is Ramazan Bahçavan (AKP). Dursunbey is noted for its wood and apples.
